directHtmlAccess: Direct canonical Wowhead URLs returned a JavaScript anti-bot challenge; English source was inspected through the assistant's web index, not GitHub Actions.
findings: Across independently indexed tank/healer/DPS guides, official spell, talent, item, enchant and boss names coexist with ordinary English prose and structured tables. Canonical ID mapping remains preferable to whole-sentence exceptions.
Localized Wowhead /fr guide indexes can still contain English prose with French official item/spell labels; URL locale is not reliable evidence of prose language.

Blood DK Mythic+ and Holy Paladin raid indexed source contain unresolved template placeholders (UTIL*_NAME, UPPER_SPEC/UPPER_CLASS, and spell=UTIL*_ID); do not attribute source authoring artifacts to MEZU or blindly translate them.

Canonical locale projection could previously fall back from a bare zh or sr label to a script-specific target (zh-CN/zh-TW or sr-Cyrl/sr-Latn) without proof that the label belongs to the requested writing system.
durableChanges: Fail-closed canonical ID locale projection when a requested locale identifies a writing script but only a generic unscripted label is present.
Regression tests verify Chinese simplified/traditional and Serbian Cyrillic/Latin separation, while preserving generic en->fr regional compatibility.
